k-anthropic.title: Anthropic $ANT IPO coins
k-anthropic.sourceSays: Posts say Anthropic's $ANT stock fell below its $83 IPO price on Nov 24; one post cites an Axios report on employees' safety fears. Coins reuse the name; one says it is not affiliated.
k-anthropic.reason: Nov 24 posts by news accounts describe the Anthropic IPO and the stock slipping below its IPO price; the coins launched hours ago on that public event. SVAG's own description disclaims affiliation.

k-wallet.reason: 'wallet' is a generic word joining unrelated coins (Ansem-wallet complaint, Sigil AI app, SVAG). SVAG posts are about an AI agent launch and belong with the Anthropic theme, not a wallet story.
